Message:
net: hns3: Adjust prefix of tx/rx statistic names

Some prefix of tx/rx statistic names are redundant, this patch modifies
these names.

The new prefix looks like below:
rxq#1_ -> rxq1_
txq#1_ -> txq1_
tx_dropped -> dropped
tx_wake -> wake
tx_busy -> busy
rx_dropped -> dropped
